subject: Quick pulse: estimate + deck landed — 15 min to walk through?
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brightline.ai>, Sara Kaplan <sara@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & estimate — Redwood + Brightline next steps

Hi Tom / Sara — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's discovery:

- Scope: 50 concurrent inference sessions for chat + embeddings, primary region us-west-2, expected monthly token volume ~1.2B.
- Key success criteria you mentioned: sub-200ms p95 for short prompts, predictable cost per 1M tokens, audit logging for model calls.

I've attached a compact pricing deck and a tailored estimate for Brightline (numbers broken down by committed vs. burst capacity). If you're good with it, I can walk a small group through the estimate and the operational tradeoffs (15 minutes suggested).

Attachments:
- Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf (PDF, 6 slides)
- Redwood_Estimate_Brightline_2024.xlsx (Excel, line-item estimate + options)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 15-minute walkthrough to confirm assumptions and any constraints we missed.
2) If fit, identify procurement/IT contacts and preferred timeline for a dedicated PO or trial.

Available this week: Thu 11:30–12:30 PT, Fri 9:00–11:00 PT. If those don't work, send a couple of slots and I'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to the momentum.

—
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brightline.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kaplan <sara@brightline.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2024 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & estimate — Redwood + Brightline next steps

Thanks for the summary, Lukas — really helpful. I confirmed receipt of both attachments (deck and estimate). We'll need to run the estimate past finance; I have a call with our Head of Ops next Tue.

Two quick Qs for the walkthrough:
- Does the estimate include a recommended batching/kv-cache configuration for chat at scale?
- Are the SLA targets in the deck tied to specific committed tiers or the Dedicated product?

If you can answer those briefly in the walkthrough that'd be ideal. Re: timing, Tue afternoon PT after my Ops sync might work — will confirm early next week.

Best,
Tom
Director of Engineering
Brightline AI
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brightline.ai>, Sara Kaplan <sara@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2024 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up & estimate — Redwood + Brightline next steps

Tom — quick pulse since I haven't heard a confirmed slot. Short answers to your questions so you can share with Ops/Finance now:
- Batching/KV cache: the estimate assumes our default chat profile with per-tenant prefix caching enabled and dynamic batching; we call out a mid/long-window KV cache option on tab 3 of the estimate. We can tune it in the walkthrough based on your request patterns.
- SLA mapping: the deck's p95 latency targets are our Dedicated tier SLOs; Hosted API has more variable tails at very low commit levels. I'll flag the exact commit thresholds during the walk.

If helpful, here are 15-minute slots I'm freeing up for you:
- Wed 4/10 10:00–10:15 PT
- Thu 4/11 11:00–11:15 PT
- Fri 4/12 09:30–09:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me two options and I'll lock it. If you'd prefer to route budget/contract questions to Marissa, I've cc'd her.

Thanks — will hold these for 24 hours.

Tom / Sara — last nudge here before I release the tentative hold. I can run the 15-minute walk-through and answer the two ops questions listed earlier. Pricing in the estimate is valid for 30 days from the original send date.

Available slots this week (PT):
- Tue 4/16 10:00–10:15
- Wed 4/17 09:00–09:15
- Thu 4/18 11:30–11:45

If one of those works, I'll send an invite and a one-page summary for Finance to speed review. If I don't hear back by EOD Thursday I'll assume you're deprioritizing and will follow up again in a few weeks.

Thanks for the consideration — happy to loop Marissa into any procurement-level questions.
